newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold demand buoyant, prices firm slightly.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold demand buoyant, prices firm slightly.

text.p: Trade on the Istanbul gold exchange remained buoyant on Monday with volume at 2,002 kg, from Friday's 2,097 kg, on continued physical demand, dealers said.
Spot gold closed only slightly firmer at $325.20 an ounce and 1,718,500 lira per gram, compared to $325.00 and 1,717,500 at the previous close.
"We are in the middle of the peak season for demand right now which is driving the market," one dealer said.
Demand for gold generally rises in the summer months due to weddings, religious festivals and tourism.
There was no trade on the exchange's gold futures market, opened on Friday.
"This shouldn't be taken to mean too much just yet, the futures market is expected to grow only slowly," a bank trader said.
The Turkish lira was unchanged against the dollar on Monday at 163,850 lira on central bank intervention.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,347 kg -- was conducted in the morning session, with 62.8 percent of the total traded in lira terms.
